task.description: Root cause diagnosis for ISS-0601-RECON-LEAK: 6,976 memory leaks in reconstruction.zig deserializeInstanceState. Leaks occur at lines 707, 709, 752 when allocating ObjectMap keys and values from JSON. This is separate from ISS-0601-LEAK-001 (parseGraphJson) which was already fixed. Analyze the allocation pattern, identify which allocator is being used, determine what needs to be freed, and design the fix strategy. Note: Arena allocator attempts in prior work (WF03-gh406 rework 2/3) caused massive test regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause identified: which specific allocations at lines 707, 709, 752 are not being freed
Fix strategy documented that avoids arena allocator pitfalls

result.summary: Root cause identified: ObjectMap keys from arena allocator are not duplicated into persistent allocator (lines 851, 904). When deserializeInstanceState returns, arena.deinit() frees all keys, leaving dangling pointers. Additionally, JsonValue objects stored as map values are never freed. Fix strategy: duplicate keys with allocator.dupe() before put(); implement freeObjectMap() helper to free keys and values before map.deinit().
